decisions.reason: As a close extension of the existing dumper line in a growing market, it preserves option value at relatively low carrying cost and shows no evidence yet that its potential has failed.
This articulated construction dumper fits the firm's established competencies and customer base, so management would usually allow more time for demand uncertainty to resolve before withdrawing it.

Because the underground mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the core range and likely costlier to support, its withdrawal risk is clearly higher, but after only one year the uncertainty is still too unresolved to justify dropping it now.

The compact telescopic loader is an adjacent product with strong technical and commercial overlap with the firm's established offer, making it a reasonable option to retain while market acceptance becomes clearer.
